relatedIssue.title: Record and qualify the trial lead Asha Rao of Rao Interiors in the CRM

detail.firstQuestionText: CRM-LEAD-2026-00001 (Asha Rao, trial) is drafted and recommended as 'Qualified' in the linked note, but I cannot set its status field myself - the CRM refuses write/read access to CRM Lead for the sales user, while FCRM Note and CRM Task work fine. Please either set the lead's status to Qualified yourself in the CRM, or grant the sales CRM user write/read permission on CRM Lead so I can do it next time. Let me know which you did (or will do).
